text: LV distribution is in four pairs of 2 x 100 % transformers on different MV sections (DEC-EPCE-0016): GT and HRSG 00BFT10/20, ST, condenser and cooling 00BFT70/80, BOP, fuel and buildings 00BFT30/40, and CW intake and pump house 00BFT50/60 (10.5/0.42 kV). Each pair feeds a main switchboard with two sections (00BFA10/20, 00BFA11/21, 00BFA12/22; MCC 00BFA40 at the CW intake), each section with its own incomer and a normally open coupler with the interlock of section 6. Redundant process equipment (2 x 100 %, 2 x 50 % + spare) shall be assigned to different sections and different MV sections so that a single busbar or transformer failure never removes both.
